source.publication: 2025 Expanded Instructions (IA 1040) and the 2025 IA 1040 Iowa Individual Income Tax Return
source.section: IA 1040 form PDF p.1 Step 3 lines a, b, d; form PDF p.2 lines 1c, 2-5, 7, 8, 11, 12; Instructions PDF p.8 Step 3; PDF p.9-10 lines 2-4; PDF p.12 line 5 ('Iowa now has a flat tax rate of 3.8%'); PDF p.18 line 12; Alternate tax, PDF p.12-13; head of household extra credit, PDF p.8

worked: Federal (given, not tested): federal AGI = wages (you) 45,625.00 = 45,625.00. Federal taxable income = 45,625.00 - standard deduction 23,625.00 - 1 x 2,000.00 for 65 or older = 20,000.00 (federal senior deduction ignored). IA 1040 filing status 4 (head of household). Step 3 line a personal credits 1 x 40.00 = 40.00; line b 1 x 20.00 = 20.00 (65 or older on or before January 1, 2026; nobody blind); line c no dependents; line d and line 8 = 60.00. Line 1c federal AGI 45,625.00; line 2 federal taxable income 20,000.00. Schedule 1: no additions or subtractions. Schedule 1 line 21 net modifications = 0.00; line 3 = 0.00. Line 4 Iowa taxable income = 20,000.00 + (0.00) = 20,000.00. Line 5 tax = 3.8% x 20,000.00 = 760.00; line 7 = 760.00. Line 11 total credits 60.00; line 12 balance = 760.00 - 60.00 = 700.00. State income tax 700.00 (no line 13-17 credits; line 19 school district or EMS surtax is local, not computed). The form allows whole-dollar rounding; expected keeps the cents. Low-income exemption and alternate tax (PDF p.10-13): line 4 20,000.00 + federal deduction 25,625.00 = 45,625.00, against 32,000.00: not exempt; alternate tax 4.3% x (45,625.00 - 32,000.00) = 585.88, smaller than the 3.8% tax. The form's figure is 485.88: alternate tax 585.88 (4.3% x 13,625.00 = 585.875) less 80.00 personal credits (2 for status 4) and 20.00. The projection uses neither the alternate tax nor the extra head of household credit, and its relief counts one person.
accepted_approximations: The low-income exemption, the alternate tax (every status except single) and the single filers' tax reduction are not applied; the record holds them in notes. The reduction's terms are not in the sources.
The extra 40 personal credit for head of household; a relief here cannot test filing status. Leaves the tax 40 too high for those filers.
School district and county EMS surtaxes (a percentage of the tax, form line 19) are local and out of scope (issue #1).
